findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list risky hostname staging.copperline.example with pattern "staging", first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; risky_hostnames_count=1, unique_hostnames=12.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging hostname suggests a non-production system may be internet-reachable with weaker controls; requires pre-close validation of exposure and segmentation. No severity adjustment from baseline.

remediation.summary: Verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly accessible or is authenticated, segmented, and decommissioned if unused; inventory all CT-visible hosts.

items.action: Verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly accessible or is authenticated, segmented, and decommissioned if unused; inventory all CT-visible hosts.

deal_recommendations.text: Before signing, obtain the current SOC 2 Type II report and complete a management security interview during Days 0–30 before relying on this rating [F-001].

Within Days 61–100 after close, verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly accessible or is authenticated, segmented, and decommissioned if unused, and inventory all CT-visible hosts, for $10K–$50K [F-001].
Financially, no adjustment is warranted because total remediation of $10K–$50K scheduled for Days 61–100 is immaterial relative to revenue [F-001].

narrative.executive_summary:
Bottom line: Proceed with conditions. Rating is B (98.4), capped because evidence is limited to outside-in signals only.

Key risks: No SOC 2 report was provided, and a publicly logged staging hostname suggests a non-production system may be internet-reachable with weaker controls [F-001].

Management credibility: Not assessed: no management interview provided.

Next steps: Obtain a current SOC 2 Type II report and complete a management security interview before relying on this rating; verify staging exposure [F-001].
key_questions_for_management: Provide evidence confirming whether staging.copperline.example is publicly accessible, authenticated, and segmented [F-001]?
Provide an inventory of all CT-visible hosts and confirm the exposure status of each host [F-001]?
Confirm the owner and completion timeline for securing or decommissioning the staging hostname within Days 61–100 [F-001]?
